name: Charged Ember
description: Throw an ember that crackles with static and stings harder than its size.

name: Crackling Glow
description: Hold a glow that crackles near living bodies and read the number by the sound.

name: Static Veil
description: Wear a veil of heat charged with static that shocks any hand that touches it.

name: Arc Ember
description: Throw an ember that arcs from target to target in a chain of small burns.

name: Flash Lash
description: Snap a lash of fire that lands in a blink and leaves the muscle jerking.

name: Surge Kindle
description: Spark the flame in the user's own arms so that every following strike lands with a jolt.

name: Snap Heat
description: Send a sharp snap of heat and force along the target's arm to break the grip.

name: Bolt Pyre
description: Drop a bolt into a pyre so that the fire flares outward in a violent ring.

name: Forked Blaze
description: Split a beam of fire into forks that pierce several guards at once.

name: Radiant Arc
description: Swing a wide arc of white-hot fire and force across the front that breaks formation.

name: Sunder Flashfire
description: streams: Fire + Lightning; strike with a burst of heat and force so sudden that the burn arrives before the flash.

name: Fanned Ember
description: Fan an ember with a sweep of the hand so it flies far and lands hot.

name: Draft Reader
description: Read the flow of air through the way a small flame leans.

name: Lifted Cinder
description: Rise a pace into the air on a draft of heat from the feet.

name: Billow Veil
description: Billow a veil of hot air and sparks that turns thrown objects aside.

name: Bellowed Flame
description: Blow a steady gout of air-fed flame across the front that grows brighter as it runs.

name: Thermal Dash
description: Ride a rush of heated air across the ground in one unbroken run.

name: Fed Fire
description: Pull air round the user in a slow spiral that feeds every flame the user holds.

name: Whirling Cinders
description: Whirl cinders on a rising draft so that sight and breath of nearby foes are lost.

name: Windswept Pyre
description: Drive a great pyre along the draft so that it sweeps the ground in a wide path.

name: Fire Whirl
description: Gather a spinning column of flame and send it walking across the ground.

name: Roaring Updraft
description: Open the ground to a roaring rise of hot air that lifts foes and burns them in the climb.

name: Kindled Tempest
description: streams: Fire + Wind; raise a vast wheel of fire and moving air that tears across the field and feeds on its own pull.

name: Molten Ember
description: Throw a heavy ember glowing like melted rock that sticks where it lands.

name: Warmed Stone
description: Harden the skin with a layer of heated stone that takes a blow and burns the hand.

name: Steam Puff
description: Spit a quick puff of scalding steam at the face to blind and startle.

name: Kiln Heat
description: Bake a steady inner heat into the arms and legs to firm the stance.

name: Baking Heat
description: Bake the earth underfoot until it cracks and burns the feet of all who stand on it.

name: Scalding Mist
description: Raise a drifting mist of scalding vapor that burns the skin and blinds the eyes.

name: Slag Lash
description: Whip a lash of melted slag that clings to cloth and burns through it.

name: Boil Touch
description: Touch the target and heat the water in the flesh until it scalds from within.

name: Crucible Burst
description: Heat a ring of ground to white heat and burst it upward round the user.

name: Scald Veil
description: Hang a curtain of scalding steam round the body that burns and hides in one.

name: Brimstone Wave
description: Send a rolling wave of choking heated stone dust and flame across the ground.

name: Kilnfire Eruption
description: Pack heat into the ground until it bursts upward in a great plume of burning stone and steam.

name: Forged Eruption
description: streams: Fire + Earth; melt the ground itself to a living flow of stone-fire that rises and carries all away.

name: Vapor Sunder
description: streams: Fire + Water; hold a wall of boiling vapor at the edge of heat and cold and crush all caught in it.

name: Living Ember
description: Light an ember in the chest that beats with the heart and warms the whole body.

name: Vital Warmth
description: Pour warmth from the user's chest into an ally to quicken healing in the hurt flesh.

name: Heartbeat Glow
description: Read the heartbeats of nearby living bodies by the pulse in a held glow.

name: Mending Coals
description: Lay glowing coals of living heat over an ally's deep wound to close it from within.

name: Purifying Ember
description: Burn a fever or a taint out of an ally's body while the vital flame stays whole.

name: Thriving Flame
description: Wrap an ally in a living flame that mends small hurts while it guards.

name: Ruddy Renewal
description: Pour a bright steady heat into an ally's body to restore strength and knit torn tissue.

name: Rekindled Breath
description: Restart the stopped breath of an ally at the edge of death with a single deep surge of living heat.

name: Spirit Furnace
description: Feed the whole party with warm strength that restores wounds and quickens the qi together.

name: Vitalfire Embrace
description: streams: Fire + Life; wrap an ally in living flame that mends wounds and burns out poison without scorching the flesh.
